title: Glowing magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='28%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbe6'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9f1a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stick' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c77dff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#9d4edd'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7b2cbf'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='star' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff3b0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd60a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura around star tip -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- wand stick -->
  <rect x='44' y='38' width='7' height='55' rx='3.5' fill='url(#stick)' transform='rotate(12 47.5 38)'/>
  <rect x='45' y='38' width='2' height='55' rx='1' fill='#e0aaff' opacity='0.6' transform='rotate(12 47.5 38)'/>

  <!-- handle band -->
  <rect x='41' y='82' width='13' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ffd60a' transform='rotate(12 47.5 86)'/>
  <rect x='42' y='83' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#fff3b0' opacity='0.7' transform='rotate(12 47.5 86)'/>

  <!-- star at the tip -->
  <g transform='translate(50 26)'>
    <polygon points='0,-18 5,-6 18,-6 8,3 12,16 0,8 -12,16 -8,3 -18,-6 -5,-6'
             fill='url(#star)'/>
    <!-- inner highlight -->
    <polygon points='0,-13 3,-4 11,-4 5,2 7,11 0,5 -7,11 -5,2 -11,-4 -3,-4'
             fill='#fffbe6' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff3b0'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='12' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='10' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='22' cy='32' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='2.5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='20' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='20' r='1.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- twinkle crosses -->
  <g stroke='#fffbe6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='25' y1='16' x2='25' y2='8'/>
    <line x1='21' y1='12' x2='29' y2='12'/>
    <line x1='73' y1='34' x2='73' y2='27'/>
    <line x1='69.5' y1='30.5' x2='76.5' y2='30.5'/>
  </g>

  <!-- tiny floating sparkle dots -->
  <g fill='#ffd60a' opacity='0.9'>
    <circle cx='60' cy='7' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='5' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='82' cy='20' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='18' cy='22' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
